module "Pr_LocalFunctionCall.dss"

product 0 MaterialFunction "MF_Inner" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="UV", InputType="Vector2", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : float2 @L4:C1 "UV"
  %1 = FunctionInput(InputName="Scale", InputType="Scalar", IsOptional=true, PreviewValue=(1, 1, 1, 1), SortPriority=1) : float @L4:C1 "Scale"
  %2 = Multiply(%0, %1) : float2 @L6:C12
  %3 = FunctionOutput(%2, OutputName="Result", SortPriority=0) @L4:C1 "Result"
  inputs %0, %1
  outputs %3

product 1 MaterialFunction "MF_Outer" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="UV", InputType="Vector2", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : float2 @L9:C1 "UV"
  %1 = FunctionInput(InputName="Scale", InputType="Scalar", IsOptional=true, PreviewValue=(1, 1, 1, 1), SortPriority=1) : float @L9:C1 "Scale"
  %2 = FunctionInput(InputName="Offset", InputType="Vector2", IsOptional=true, PreviewValue=(0, 0, 0, 1), SortPriority=2) : float2 @L9:C1 "Offset"
  %3 = FunctionCall[MF_Inner](UV=%0, Scale=%1, FunctionPath="", LocalFunction=0) : [Result:float2] @L11:C12
  %4 = Add(%3, %2) : float2 @L11:C12
  %5 = FunctionOutput(%4, OutputName="Result", SortPriority=0) @L9:C1 "Result"
  inputs %0, %1, %2
  outputs %5
